comments.author: Sylvia
comments.body: These ships fell out of the sky like rain a few months ago. A lot of unscrupulous people tried to pass them off as some kind of super ship, as you can see in the posts here. It is a ship that fills a very particular niche and it is a ship that you will outgrow very quickly if you play with any regularity at all. It is not worth a tremendous amount of ducats because as someone stated earlier, you would do well to spend the same amount of money on EA goods and get your levels up to be able to use bigger better faster ships.
